verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents percentage rollouts through a % Split segment rule (any value from 1 to 100, applied globally or within a segment), and flag changes are made remotely without deploying new code, so a 1%→100% ramp is supported. The docs never say users are bucketed consistently as the percentage grows, so that part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented consistent/deterministic bucketing (sticky assignment by identity as the percentage increases), independent or hands-on corroboration of the ramp behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying

citations.quote: Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, either globally or within a segment.
Specify a value between 1 and 100 to define what percentage of your user base is included within this segment.
Rollouts by percentage (also known as staged feature rollouts) allow you to test a new feature with a small subset of your user base.
make changes without deploying new code
